work.summary: Closed the bounded FINAL.17 field-maintenance cycle. Post-confirm OCR capture now guides continuation/end-of-visit choices; explicit no-input/no-recovery visit facts handle legitimate no-service cases without fabricated zero reports; materially overlapping sales periods fail closed before OCR draft creation and again at confirmation to prevent cumulative-journal double-counting. PR #105 merged, matching Vercel production is READY, GitHub Pages serves FINAL.17, and live regression gates pass.
implemented: OCR report drafts now attach to a shared Analytics visit for the current capture session so follow-up sales/input/recovery papers can be resolved as one visit.
After explicit report confirmation, compact review offers context-sensitive follow-up actions such as continuing with input/recovery capture or explicitly ending with no input/no recovery.
Added explicit no-input visit resolution alongside the existing no-recovery concept; neither path fabricates a zero-quantity report.
Visit completeness now treats explicit confirmed-none input/recovery resolutions as resolved while preserving actual report movements when present.
Defined and validated the previously referenced recoveryResolution helper and added symmetric inputResolution normalization/validation.
Sales OCR draft creation checks the candidate previousClearAt→occurredAt interval against prior confirmed sales for the same maker/vendor and blocks true overlap.
Sales confirmation re-checks overlap, preventing a stale or manually-created overlapping draft from becoming confirmed.
Adjacent periods are allowed; a five-minute tolerance is limited to boundary/clock noise.
Analytics engine version bumped to AN14B3B3; DB/schema remain 4 and forecast numeric behavior is unchanged.

Added a dedicated browser/IndexedDB/mobile gate covering overlap detection, adjacent-period allowance, sales-only no-service completion, input-with-no-recovery completion, post-confirm choices, and 320px layout.
Aligned the existing OCR correction regression gate cache marker to FINAL.17.
Merged PR #105 to main at c3c3155c2b2e1339fe8faac101014899b4a6b67b.
Verified matching Vercel production deployment dpl_J4t3q4P4s23PUU8Jw9CLqTG9wYwG is READY.

Ran the live GitHub Pages visit-closeout/overlap gate and existing OCR correction regression gate; both passed.
